children.value: A simple way is to count grid points that is inside the unit circle. A quick

function compute_area_of_circle(n)
    cover::Int = 0
    for i in -n:n
        for j in -n:n
            if ((i/n)^2 + (j/n)^2) < 1
                if i == 0 && j == 0
                    cover += 4
                elseif i == 0 || j == 0 
                    cover += 2
                else 
                    cover += 1
                end 
            end
        end
    end
    return cover * (1/n)^2
end
